steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: What the hell are those things up in the sky?!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Get down!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Urgh! *cough* *cough* *cough!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Delphine, your right hand—

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Don't touch.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: This isn't any normal cannonfire. Sarkaz witchcraft... is corrosive in nature. I won't be much help.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Those people still trapped in the polluted area...

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: It's too late for them.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You got shit in the air, stuff growing on the ground, AND crystals and dust everywhere! Can't even take a damn step!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Sarkaz want to turn this battlefield into their home turf – forcing us to put down our gear and cower while they pummel us.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: When it comes to a head-to-head infantry battle, the Sarkaz will surely have an advantage due to their natural physique.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Alright, I get it now. It's all just a dirty trick!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Which is why we can't afford to get caught off guard. If they ever get the drop on us, we're done for on the spot.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Morgan, get as many of our vehicles up and running as you can. Avoid any close combat with Sarkaz infantry.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Even if a vehicle's destroyed, don't overlook the mounted cannon. They're the best weapons we've got.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Delphine,send the signalers out as widely as you feasibly can. The Exemplars will be able to maintain communication that way, at the least.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If we want to push forward, we're going to have to take down that altar up ahead.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Horn, covering fire!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Roger!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Indra, your team's responsible for holding the enemy back. Doesn't matter if it's casters or Arts Creations or whatever those things are up in the sky.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You got it.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Dagda's team, you're with me.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Same as always?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Same as always.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I can see the core – move out.
Another altar of Sarkaz witchcraft.
Climb, pull up, leap, bring down the hammer.
As the war rages on, they've become more and more familiar with these war machines resembling the devils' eyes.
They've become more and more familiar with war itself.
Vina often feels as if Indra, Morgan, and Dagda have changed somewhat. She trusts that the very same changes can be seen in her.
Is it a change for the better? Or a change that came far too late?
The devil's crimson eye stares at her.
The hammer comes down hard, and the altar begins to collapse before Siege even reaches the ground.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: It worked! Phew...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: We took it down even quicker than the last one.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I hear something.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Back up!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Something's... growin' outta that bloody thing! It's another altar, not far from the one we knocked down!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: How many of these little buggers did they bury in the ground? Bloody hell...
There's no end to them.
Siege tightly grips her hammer.
They are adapting. But not quickly enough.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Trilby Asher, has the location of the Stone of the Sword changed?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I haven't been notified of any changes to the plan.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Can the ship still move, with all the Originium crystals everywhere?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I'll have you know, Victoria has the most powerful fleet on land.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: We might be slowed a little, but we're certainly not without options.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I hear naval guns.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I believe it's the Iron Duke's Gastrell, going by the sound.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The next round of our assault is beginning.

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: One of Abercorn's assault ships has run into the Sarkaz advance brigade!

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: The enemy was hiding in the fog and suddenly appeared–

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: Our vision is severely limited by the Originium crystals and we can't follow their movements at all!

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Has mid-range communication been restored yet?

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: The ship's comm tower is still out of commission. Engineering's trying to repair it, but in this Originium-dense zone...

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: Your Grace, what are you doing on deck?

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: There's Originium dust everywhere outside, please try not to leave the command center...

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: I've heard that Wellington always stands on the deck of the Gastrell, personally commanding his frontline troops.

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: The Iron Duke has been through many battles, but you...

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Just now, the Gastrell opened fire.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Your ears did not deceive you.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Is he still pressing forward?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I'm afraid so. The Iron Duke's forces have penetrated deeper than we thought, and are about to collide with the Sarkaz core units.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Wellington...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Does he plan to take the head of the Sarkaz regent?

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: The Wesley Wellington I knew was indeed a warrior before he became the Iron Duke.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: His bravery might have bordered on madness... but he would never gamble with the outcome of a battle.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Regardless, the Iron Duke's recklessness has placed us at great risk.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: As per the initial orders, Duke Abercorn's and Duke Ashworth's men are following the Iron Duke... and among them, our vanguard as well.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Factoring in the surrounding Originium, our front line is being stretched thin.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: What of the 'eyes' you placed aboard the Gastrell?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Nothing yet.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Even us Trilby Ashers are experiencing some... serious delays in communication.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Aileen, confirm the status of the Stone of the Sword.

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: No issues so far!

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: We will never allow the Stone of the Sword to be tainted by Sarkaz witchcraft.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Your Grace, the Poet has launched a flare.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: So Alexandrina and the Sighs of Kings will arrive soon.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Have your people keep a close eye on them. Don't let the sword get lost on the battlefield.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: We must put the Sighs of Kings to work immediately.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Unless the comms are restored fully... the so-called ducal alliance is a non-entity.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The enemy seems to be getting stronger.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The same witchcraft... eats away at us while strengthening them.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege, watch out!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Argh—!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Dagda!
The hammer falls, and a portion of the Nachzehrer warrior's body is caved in.
But he continues to advance.
A second swing. Then a third.
Dagda leaps back, splitting his waist with her metal claws.
The Trilby Asher's flaming blade pierces his chest.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: (Dull gasps)

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: That's just one. There are still... many more ahead.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: These Sarkaz are truly...

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Monsters!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: These bloody devils are all monsters, goddamn it! They're not even flesh-and-blood !

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Do you think they're already dead? Only the dead can...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Already dead...?
Strange noises can be heard in all directions.
They are distinct from the sounds of Originium crystal clusters piercing the ground. They are not omens to the explosion of Originium dust.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Captain, we can't hold out like this!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: There's no end to them!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Better focus on the one right in front of you, then.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: There's always going to be someone standing up front.
Raise the shield, fire the cannon. Repeat, ad infinitum.
Victoria possesses the strongest weapons in all of Terra. One shell can easily blow apart a Sarkaz's armor.
Just as quickly, two more Sarkaz rush forth at the same time to take the place. Then three.
The artillery fire unleashes its fury, but it cannot stem the surging tide.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: *huff*... *pant*...
There's no end to the enemies.
She can hardly tell how many Sarkaz are on the ground in front of her; some standing, some lying.
The number of fallen Victorians is perhaps even greater.
She can hear Bagpipe's shouts and the whistling of her spear. From those she finds utmost solace, and that's enough to keep her fighting on.
A plume of firelight suddenly springs up not too far away.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Bagpipe...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What is it, Captain?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I think... I just saw Hill again.
Oh, Hill.
That same face again. The same face that appears in her nightmares every now and then, reminding her of how tragically her teammates died... The face of that traitor.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ...He's dead.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Is he that one... lyin' over there? Seems to have been killed in action some time ago... Um, Captain, just now, did he...?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: He moved.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: He's... standing up again.
The man clad in the uniform of Wellington's forces staggers towards them.
He lifts the blade in his hands, and slashes at the Sarkaz in front of Horn.
The armor is too thick, and the recoil pushes his hands away. His arms contort strangely and he strikes a second time, then a third.
That familiar visage is getting closer and closer to them–
In the midst of the dead silent gray, only a tiny speck of purple dances.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: It's her.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: It's... Dublinn!
'I lay down now my soldier's honor here, so that in time the soil of Tara need no longer be soaked in carmine blood, and Draco cross no swords with Draco kin.'
'Be that unless a day comes, whereupon Red Dragon's flame should lead all those that fell, our fighters from the forge to be reborn.'

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: The third set of altars has been crushed!

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Milady, our casters and flying soldiers are in position. We're about to approach the largest altar!

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Our deceased compatriots have managed to protect us from the devils' vile pollution, but the destructive power of their witchcraft is unprecedented!

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Allow me.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: ...Milady?

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: You're... going to destroy the altar yourself?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: You, as my subjects, have done all you needed to do.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: I, as your sovereign, ought to lead you forward.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: How can I take this land as my own if I have never set foot upon it?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: The Red Dragon's flame... shall fall upon the battlefield's front lines, just as it has for thousands of years.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ––Our altar's being razed!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Stay in formation! Don't get scattered by those flames – keep casting!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: They're nothing but a ragtag bunch of impotent outbloods–

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: I wouldn't be so sure about that.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: We are nothing like those Victorians who have it easy.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Every Taran warrior has been forged within the shadows, tempered by pain and suffering.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: We were once known as specters, for we knew most intimately the scent of death.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I won't let you–!

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Trying to turn yourself into an Arts catalyst... to detonate the altar?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: As you wish.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I'm... too late...
The spark of life gradually fades.
And in its place burns a deathly purple flame, leaping across the body of the slain Sarkaz warrior just as it dances in Eblana's eyes.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: There is no Royal Court in death's domain.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Sarkaz, your people know death so well... only because you've fought enough wars.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: See that?

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Death itself stands with us! Our enemies are not inscrutable demons!

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Drag those Sarkaz out from their pretentious Arts Circles and give them a taste of our crossbows and cannons!

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Brigadier... I see a flame burning within your eyes.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: I've waited far too long for this, just like countless other Taran warriors.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: All of us grew up hearing the legends of the Empire's Death Knell, and enlisted with burning fervor in our hearts!

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: But over the last few decades, Wellington's administrator and the Duke have had their hands tied, and we've also been caught between the cracks of the other dukes' negotiation tables.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: So many hot-blooded warriors were repressed because of their background, while many others perished in the Victorians' conspiracies.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: I've endured for so many years, even to see myself turn into a scheming villain, all for the sake of witnessing a real war – not one ignited by the nobles' petty power-jockeying.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Only on such a battlefield can a warrior's death be glorious and meaningful.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: If I am to die in this battle–

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Then please bestow upon me your flames so that I may stand once more!

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Until my remains are consumed fully by the fire, until our promised nation has been established, I shall never lay down my arms!

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Excellent. Now then, come with me.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Do you see... that throne of deadwood?

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: That's the Sarkaz leader.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: The Nachzehrer, Nezzsalem. He who calls himself the lord of war and death.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: The Sarkaz Royal Court sure has a thing for these overblown titles.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Overblown...? Hardly.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: He just happens to be ancient enough.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: But, he is not the only living legend here.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Why of course!
Not far away, naval guns roar.
Ancient witchcraft is not the only force that can cause mountains to move.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Now, let us pit war against war... and death against death.

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: My Patriarch, the hunt has been cut short.

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: That Draco's flames have broken our formation.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: ...Draco.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Thousands of years ago, after the Sarkaz first lost their homeland, they once did battle against a red dragon on this very soil.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Those flames turned fields of Sarkaz into charred stone. They are still beside us, and beneath our feet.

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: We will slay her.

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: A red dragon will sate our appetite for a while.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: She is not the one who drives this war.
The Nachzehrer King turns his gaze towards a certain part of the battlefield.
Behind the Red Dragon's smoke and flames, a huge shadow is rushing toward them at an unexpected speed.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: A titan that casts a shadow across the land, able to shake mountains and rivers with but a single breath–

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: No longer is it a mere red dragon.
'All parameters set!'
'Loading complete!'
'Firing interference shells!'
'Target locked on–'
'Main guns, first salvo!'

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: Confirmed hit!

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: General, we've swept the obstacles away.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Gastrell, all ahead full.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Our objective – the Nachzehrer's throne.
The naval guns roar.
Wellington is well-acquainted with his most loyal subject – the oldest gun aboard the ship, that which assisted him in blowing open the gates of Lingones.
He killed the mightiest nomadic city on Terra. He pulled the spine from its corpse and made it a part of his warship.
Afterwards, he took the Gastrell to many lands, and conquered many foes.

The Arts orbs of Leithanian casters, the shields of Ursine vanguards, the golden blades of Sargonian assassins – he collected and modified the most valuable components of his enemies, and placed them upon his flagship.
But not for the sake of commemoration. Only those who have become weak and frail through the passage of time need to rely on these vestiges to remember the past.
The Gastrell must step over the bones of its enemies, assimilating their power so that it may become stronger.
Only this way can the two of them defeat even stronger enemies together.

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: Intercept them!

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: The crystal barrier... has been shattered.

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: The enemy continues to advance.

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: How they must long for death, using artillery fire to cleave a path.
Wave after wave of cannonfire pours down onto the sea of Originium.
Golden fragments crack and split apart, revealing a gap within those congealed waves.

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: How dare they... approach us––
A thick haze envelops the battleship.
Countless Nachzehrer warriors land on its deck, the entire vessel enveloped in the glow of witchcraft.
Rend, dismantle, corrode.
The cadence of gunfire gradually slows.
The hard, steel hull is being digested, just like all other prey that has fallen into the Nachzehrers' Arts circles.

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: Capture... complete...

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Not yet.
He lifts his scepter.
Branches grow rapidly from beneath the throne, blocking the front of the Nachzehrer warriors.
A shell lodges within the branches.
A few seconds later, the shell explodes, tearing the branches asunder.
For the first time since the battle began, the Nachzehrer's throne shakes.

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: My Patriarch!

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: It matters not.
From the thick haze of corruption, the warship slowly comes into view.
Its outer layer flayed off by the corruption, almost half its main and secondary guns disabled due to the bombardment of witchcraft shells, only the steel frame remains shining.
Yet she is nevertheless still Gastrell, the mightiest warship in the land.
And her master–
The Sarkaz atop the throne lowers his head, noticing a faint shadow among the crystal clusters.

steps.name: Redsteel Guard Member
steps.text: General, the Gastrell has successfully drawn the attention of the main Sarkaz force!

steps.name: Redsteel Guard Member
steps.text: They didn't even notice that we were transferred from the main ship–

steps.name: Redsteel Guard Member
steps.text: Wait, something's coming in fast!

steps.name: Redsteel Guard Member
steps.text: Guardsmen, tighten your formation!
A salvo of artillery fire.
Only a few tiny twigs fall from the smoke and dust.
The force that was enough to shatter those crystalline waves cannot even shake the figure floating in the air.
The Nachzehrer King casts his gaze down upon the commander at the center of the army. Not far behind the old Feline, the bloodthirsty warship is waiting, eager to tear at his rotting flesh.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Duke... of Victoria.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: We have devoured many Victorians. General, Duke. Whatever the title, they all tasted the same.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Conspirators. Merchants. But none of their warriors.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: They saw the battlefield as little more than a sandbox atop a table. The soldiers, mere chess pieces; war itself, only a tool for power and profit. How frivolous war was to them.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: But, you are different. Your ship has also feasted on many enemies.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Ursine. Leithanian. Gaulish... And, Sarkaz. I can smell their flesh.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: They have also been absorbed by the Nachzehrers.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Sarkaz... I've read plenty of records about you.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: The ancient Nachzehrers, with a tenth of the Victorian Army's numbers, were able to halt their advance on Kazdel.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: A feat of war that defies all reason, one that cannot be taught in military academies or replicated.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Are you here to take revenge?

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Haha. My only regret is that I hadn't been born two hundred years ago.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: They apparently call you the 'God of War'?

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: No. There are no gods when it comes to war.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: There only exists... the moment of victory or defeat.
Wellington draws his sword and points it at the Sarkaz in midair.
Behind him, all the guns on his ship are pointed in the same direction.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Nezzsalem, I will defeat you.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Just like all the other mighty foes that have fallen at my hands.
